build_pair_representation_model: build a PairRepresentation model with BiLSTMDocAttention subrepresentation for sentence pair encoding
create_pair_representation_config: create a PairRepresentation Config with encode_relations true and custom subrepresentation settings
run_pair_representation_forward: run the forward pass of PairRepresentation with left and right sentence embeddings and lengths

review_pair_representation_siamese_encod: review the PairRepresentation siamese encoding that concatenates difference and elementwise product
